name: The Hundred Legions
desc:
A superpower native to the Western Luminant, the Hundred Legions are a powerful empire boasting, as the name implies, a hundred legions of soldiers. They once allied themselves with The Authority, but were betrayed. The 11th Scouting Legion were sent to the East to gather information of the conflicts going on there. Their ranks consist mainly of Khans, but they are open to recruiting other aspects. They are creators of the Legion Kata fighting style and masters of Galebreathe as the only way to train your Galebreathe is through Gale Kata, described to be made by the Legion.

The Legion has several war heroes that are depicted by either their ornaments or their weapons, an example being the Legion Shield. Examples of war heroes are Akilles and Acheron. Akilles, who was in charge of the 11th Legion and brought them to the East when an imminent conflict was brewing, and Acheron who is the owner of the infamous Acheron's Warspear who seemingly lost it to a King Thresher, but survived, and can be found in Aratel Island as part of the Legion Kata questline.

**Legions**

The Hundred Legions consists of one hundred legions.

-   The 11th Legion.
    -   consists of [Amara](entity:amara), [Atra](entity:atra), [Caitus](entity:caitus), [Gaius](entity:gaius), and [Lars](entity:lars).
    -   Has associated outfit, 11th Legion Plate.
-   The 21st Legion.
    -   Has an associated Specialist set style.
-   The 49th Legion.
    -   consists of Polymarch Legion Soldiers and [General Titus Juventius](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus), now known as [Titus Fulminus Destellus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus).
    -   Has an associated Specialist set style.
-   The 77th Legion.
    -   Implied to be the inventers of the Imperator's Fury
-   The 84th Legion.
    -   Has an associated Specialist set style.

Other notable members of the hundred legions.

-   The Evanspear Centurion.
    -   Has associated equipment, Evanspear War set and Reinforced War set.
    -   Has an associated weapon, the Evanspear Greataxe
-   The Immortals
    -   Has an associated Specialist set style.
additional_info:
-   Their aesthetic draws from the Greek and Roman empires.
-   From the camp in [The Viper's Jaw](location:the_vipers_jaw) we can meet a Khan with an unobtainable aspect variant, meaning that there might be more types of Khans than the ones that have made their way in the East.
-   Considering that the Battle Royale map is of Legion territory, The Hundred Legions is the first faction to get its own exclusive game mode, and by extension, the only ones to have a server wholly dedicated to them.
-   [Evengarde Rest](entity:evengarde_rest) had fought alongside the Legion against [the Starkindred Church](faction:the_starkindred_church) in the West, upon doing so he had acquired the Pale Briar. This implies they once were in good standing with the Etreans. However, their intrusion in the east means the two are now prone to skirmishing.
